Google Business Profile video verification can fail even when it feels like you showed everything.

Before you record again, make three things easy to review:

1. Where the business operates
2. What the business uses to do real work
3. Why you are authorized to manage it

Plan one continuous route. Keep it short and clear. Show signage, paperwork, branded materials, or equipment when they strengthen the proof, but protect private information.

If the video is rejected, read the issue Google reports, fix that missing proof, and try again. Repeated failures may need a support review.

Google Business Profile video verification is not about making the longest video. It is about making the right evidence easy to see.

I have helped multiple service businesses through this process, and I have had videos fail even after I believed everything was there. That is why I do not promise a magic checklist.

Start with three types of proof: the business location, real operations or equipment, and proof that you manage the business. Plan one continuous route and keep it short. If the video is rejected, use the issue Google reports to make the next attempt clearer. After repeated failures, contact support and ask for a human review.

I have helped multiple service businesses through Google Business Profile video verification, and I have had my own videos fail even after I believed I showed everything.

That is why I do not promise a magic checklist. I focus on making three things easy for a reviewer to understand:

• Where the business operates
• What proves it is a real operating business
• What proves the person recording is authorized to manage it

The practical part is the route. Start with a recognizable location marker. Move to the vehicle or workspace. Show equipment, branded materials, or business documents. Finish with a business-only asset or another clear form of management proof.

Keep it continuous, short, and easy to review. If Google rejects it, address the specific issue shown in the verification flow. Repeated failures may require support and a human review.
